manifest.title: Zammad
manifest.author: Johan Cappi
manifest.postInstallMessage:
On first visit, Zammad's setup wizard will ask you to create the initial admin account and configure basic settings.

Notes:
* Elasticsearch is not bundled with this package; full-text search is disabled by default (`ELASTICSEARCH_ENABLED=false`).
* Attachments are stored in the PostgreSQL database by default. You can switch to filesystem storage at any time from **Admin > System > Storage** without losing data; filesystem storage uses Cloudron's persistent app storage.

manifest.author: Johan Cappi
manifest.changelog: * Fix: PostgreSQL database creation (POSTGRESQL_DB_CREATE=false) to match Cloudron's PostgreSQL addon, which pre-creates the app database and restricts access to it

manifest.title: Zammad
manifest.author: Johan Cappi
manifest.changelog: * Add Cloudron Single Sign-On support via the oidc addon ("Login with Cloudron" using Zammad's generic OpenID Connect provider). Requires a fresh install to take effect.

manifest.title: Zammad
manifest.author: Johan Cappi
manifest.changelog: * Fix: disable PKCE in the Cloudron OIDC single sign-on configuration; Cloudron's OIDC authorization endpoint rejected the request with "invalid_request" when PKCE was enabled alongside a public client (no client_secret transmitted)

manifest.title: Zammad
manifest.author: Johan Cappi
manifest.changelog: * Fix: inject Cloudron's OIDC client_secret (CLOUDRON_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET) into Zammad's OpenID Connect client via a small Rails initializer patch. Cloudron's OIDC addon provisions a confidential client and rejects the token exchange with "invalid_request: client_secret must be provided" otherwise; Zammad's built-in generic OIDC integration has no Setting field for a client secret (public/PKCE-only by design)
